_comment: Production config rows that exist ONLY in the database (not produced by repos/database seeds or reconcile). Captured 2026-11-02 from org og_0000001. Secret VALUES are not stored here: re-enter them (via admin UI or /_/secrets) and they are re-encrypted with TDSK_MASTER_KEY.

secrets.name: ADVERSARY_GIT_PAT
secrets.description: lancetipton CLASSIC repo-scoped PAT for the adversary review job. Classic (not fine-grained) is REQUIRED: fine-grained PATs cannot resolveReviewThread and main has required_conversation_resolution=true, so approved-after-changes PRs would stall. Posts as lancetipton because the threadedstack-adversary machine account is GitHub shadow-banned (its reviews are invisible to others). Scope: repo (+write:discussion), no workflow.

functions.name: scoreDesignPartnerCandidates
functions.description: Ranks the 7 shortlisted design-partner candidates (rec_lg5O8L) by fit against the two rec_2Rh6ti differentiators (nested tenancy need, any-API secrets breadth need) plus reachability, to sequence outreach. Static reference data — updates when the shortlist changes.
